290877: The seventh prince of the royal family that rules the Kingdom of Saloum. He was reincarnated and grows up with the memories of his previous life as a sorcerer.
290878: A demon who uses the old magic and once drove the Kingdom of Saloum into the verge of collapse. After being sealed inside of a forbidden tome that was locked away in the kingdom's sealed archive for several centuries, he's released by Lloyd and they have their first encounter.
318357: Part of the Assassins Guild, whose members all have bounties on their heads.
318358: A martial artist that uses a foreign breathing method that gives access to superhuman abilities, known as “Qi”. After a life dedicated wholly to training, she fled her dojo to become an adventurer in pursuit of a fateful meeting with a handsome man.
318359: Lloyd's loyal maid, who serves the Kingdom of Saloum. In charge of his education and his protection. Has mastery with a blade that adventurers envy, along with the alias "The Silver Blade Princess." Seems very kind at first, but rigorous when it comes to training with a sword.
325994: After assembling a group of other Blighted, he created the Assassin's Guild, acting as its leader. Known as the Phantom Blighted, his power will teleport him to random locations regardless of his own will.
329066: The fourth prince of the Saloum Kingdom, and one of Lloyd's older brothers.
329067: The second prince of the Saloum Kingdom, and one of Lloyd's older brothers. The current heir to the throne with both martial and academic ability.
329068: The sixth princess of the Saloum Kingdom, Lloyd's older sister. With her personal maid, Eris, she keeps a menagerie of her favorite animals in the castle's "Boxed Garden Tower", and spends her days leisurely looking after them.
329069: One of the four wild bearwolf monsters that live in the forest. After being doused in Lloyd's magic power he transforms into a white, fluffy form, earning him the name "Shiro." With a keen sense of smell and a massive body, he can transport Lloyd and Sylpha around with ease.
335797: The Warp Blighted, whose joints are unnaturally flexible, allowing him to fit through even the smallest of spaces, like a rodent, earning him the name "Babylon the Giant Rat.
335798: The Pain Blighted, whose ability allows her to link with anyone she sees, at which point she and her target will share any injuries either suffers. Given the nature of her power, she often harms herself as a tactic in battle, earning her the name "Talia the Hundred Pains.
335799: With the ability to imbue his words with mana, he is the Curse Blighted. Because anything he says will be affected by his mana, he normally wears a bird-like mask, which has earned him the name "Crow the Dark Raptor.
335800: The Web Blighted, who converts the mana that covers his body into a sticky fluid. After Jade returns to his homeland for personal reasons, Galilea finds himself in charge of the Assassin's Guild. He fights by using a combination of his webs and his powerful frame.
354431: A kind-hearted nun serving at a church in the Dane district of the Kingdom of Saloum. Renowned for her beautiful singing voice and her ability to heal others, Escher has a past connection with Lloyd.
354432: The fourth princess of the Kingdom of Saloum and Lloyd’s older sister. She is deeply knowledgeable about music and has mastered various instruments but shows little interest in anything outside of music.
363529: A priest whom Babylon encounters in the courtyard of the church. Though he has long served the gods, he is curiously prone to forgetting his rosary—an object of deep importance to any clergyman. His true nature remains shrouded in mystery.
363530: A devout apostle of the 64 Gods of the Celestial Realm and a messenger of the divine. He is a powerful being who wields the strength of the gods and grants the use of Holy Magic, capable of purifying evil.
